description: This header file defines APIs for managing GRE interface objects in a data model library, including functions for retrieving, setting, validating, and committing interface parameters.

methods.name: GreIf_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of GRE interface entries.

methods.name: GreIf_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific GRE interface entry based on index.

methods.name: GreIf_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets a boolean parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: GreIf_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets an unsigned long parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: GreIf_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets a string parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: GreIf_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Gets an integer parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: GreIf_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: GreIf_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: GreIf_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: GreIf_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value for a GRE interface.

methods.name: GreIf_Validate
methods.description: Validates the parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: GreIf_Commit
methods.description: Commits the changes made to the GRE interface parameters.

methods.name: GreIf_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back any uncommitted changes to the GRE interface parameters.

methods.name: GreIfStat_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves statistical unsigned long value for GRE interface.
